integrity: All accompanying files are complete UTF-8 source texts and independent hash-checked contents. Numerical checks supplement a self-contained exact proof.
scientific_limitations: One fixed four-dimensional Hermitian matrix and a specified simple interior-eigenvalue branch of a two-dimensional Gaussian square sketch. Exact arithmetic, no automatic pair selection, no oversampling or finite-precision claims. The prior probability law of Gaussian ratios is classical; potential equivalent specialized past calculations remain a historical-priority risk.
title: An exact finite-angle law and logarithmic mean-risk penalty for Gaussian randomized Rayleigh–Ritz refinement
